evidence.detail: nav.showing gets z-index:4 and box-shadow: var(--elevation-4) — this is the mobile drawer shadow
status-bar has z-index:2 and box-shadow: var(--elevation-2); at narrow widths it is position:absolute top:0, which could cast downward onto header content
No direct box-shadow on the header element itself — shadow must come from an overlapping positioned element

triage.notes: Cannot confirm or deny whether the shadow is still present without a live browser. The most likely source is the status-bar's elevation-2 shadow casting downward onto header content at narrow widths. Static analysis is insufficient to verify current state.
